matched_rules.because: Server temperatures are rising above optimal operating conditions during a planned system upgrade, indicating the datacenter is approaching safe operational thresholds and the thermal buffer may be depleting.

next_actions.action: Treat the thermal buffer as a finite resource and act before it is depleted; expect that once the buffer is gone, temperature will exceed safe operational thresholds and automated device shutdown will begin; recognize that in parts of the datacenter temperature can rise so quickly that hardware is damaged before it can shut down.

escalate.reason: Thermal buffer depletion is imminent or automated shutdowns have started, as server temperatures rise above optimal operating conditions during a planned system upgrade.

not_covered: The planned system upgrade itself and its potential role in causing or exacerbating the cooling issue is not addressed by any rule.
